worldcombat.skill.grudge.summary: Sets a grudge on the spot: for a while, whoever personally brings you down has all the PP of the move that finished you stripped away. It does not shield you - it only makes "finishing me personally" cost something afterwards. Setting another while one is already on you fails.
worldcombat.skill.grudge.use.0: Punish the foe that insists on landing the finishing blow
worldcombat.skill.grudge.use.1: Strip a foe's key move so it can never be used again
worldcombat.skill.grudge.use.2: Cripple the move a foe relies on as you go down
worldcombat.skill.grudge.description.0: The grudge stays on you for %1$s and its eye ring is %2$s blocks across; during that time whoever personally brings you down has the PP of the move it just used zeroed.
worldcombat.skill.grudge.description.1: Setting it takes %1$s and gathers %2$s motes, with a %3$s cooldown. If the killer is not a Pokemon, or its last move cannot be read, the grudge only strikes empty air.
worldcombat.skill.grudge.deep.0: Deep: a longer grudge, but you are rooted on the spot the whole time and the cooldown is longer.
worldcombat.skill.grudge.deep.1: Light: a shorter grudge, but you keep your footing and the cooldown is shorter - and it disperses sooner.
worldcombat.skill.grudge.timing: Cast on yourself: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.grudge.preference.deep: On: grudge duration x1.5, rooted throughout, cooldown x1.2. Off (Light): duration x0.85, free movement, cooldown x0.85. Trade how long the grudge lasts for whether you can still walk.
worldcombat.skill.grudge.preference.ai.t: The partner sets the grudge only below this health ratio; larger prices the finishing blow sooner, smaller keeps it for the last moment.
worldcombat.skill.grudge.preference.ai.m: The partner considers the grudge only while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger chases out.
worldcombat.skill.grudge.preference.ai.l: When on, the partner will also leave its post to set the grudge.
world_combat.move.grudge.text.drain: Grudge: that move's PP is stripped
